name: IUPAC solid–liquid equilibrium reference observations
description: Literature-compiled reference solubility/liquidus observations for ten binary solid–liquid equilibrium systems, with source identifiers and accepted/rejected flags.
version: NIST mds2-2807 data release issued 2023-03-17; files checked 2026-11-01
count_scope: Numeric source-tagged rows in ten *_SLE*.xlsx tables only; includes 21 explicitly rejected R rows, which must remain distinguishable from 3,425 accepted rows. Other property workbooks not added.
license: Catalog declares NIST data-use terms; separate redistribution rights of compiled third-party measurements not verified

sources.title: Data.gov agency release metadata
sources.evidence: Attached ranks 88/91. Identifies NIST ark:/88434/mds2-2807, publication DOI, ZIP/README routes and a NIST license-policy link.

sources.title: IUPAC data README
sources.evidence: Maps twenty workbooks to the technical-report figures and distinguishes solid-liquid, vapor-liquid, liquid-liquid, excess enthalpy and activity-coefficient data.

sources.title: Inspected IUPAC reference archive
sources.evidence: Independently counted 3,446 source-tagged observations in ten SLE tables: 3,425 accepted and 21 R-rejected; headers define mole fraction, temperature scale, source codes and pressure context.

caveats: A specialized solid/solution thermodynamic reference set, not a crystal-coordinate database.
Do not train on R-rejected observations as accepted targets; preserve those curation flags.
Ten binary systems and twenty workbooks are not 3,446 independent materials. Repeated digitized/literature observations may share experiments.
Pressure and mole fraction occupy different columns in two workbooks; parse by explicit header instead of fixed column offsets.
Uncertainty completeness and underlying source-paper rights were not independently established for every measurement.

additional_counts.scope: Blank status flag according to workbook definitions
Explicit R status; excluded from accepted observations

count_derivation.method: Header-mapped count of numeric source-tagged x1/T data rows in ten SLE tables
